author: Antigravity2
summary: Retirement of handwritten Map/TTL query caches in favor of scoped TanStack Query v5 client, with AbortSignal cancellation threading to BFF transport, double-audit F12/S05 verification and negative bundle reachability confirmation.

retired_caches.replacement: TanStack Query v5 via useQuery and queryKeys.resource() scoped by tenantId, userId, baseUrl, and mode.
retired_caches.evidence: Handwritten v5LiveCache Map removed; queries now managed via queryClient and getActiveQueryScope().

retired_caches.replacement: TanStack Query v5 queryClient cache via queryKeys.operations.list() scoped by tenantId, userId, baseUrl, and mode.
retired_caches.evidence: Handwritten operationListCache Map and loadCachedListItems/updateCachedListItems migrated to queryClient.getQueryData/setQueryData and invalidateQueries.

query_key_scoping.token_handling: NEVER use auth tokens, JWTs, or bearer secrets as query keys or cache keys.

isolation_guarantees.tenant_isolation: Verified by double-audit F12/S05 test: switching tenant changes scope key and prevents cross-tenant data leakage.
isolation_guarantees.identity_isolation: Verified by double-audit F12/S05 test: switching user/operator changes scope key and isolates cached reads.
isolation_guarantees.environment_isolation: Verified by double-audit F12/S05 test: baseUrl/mode changes isolate cached reads.
isolation_guarantees.stale_inflight_discard: Verified by double-audit F12/S05 test: responses from prior scopes cannot overwrite active scope data.
isolation_guarantees.logout_cleanup: Verified by double-audit F12/S05 test: AuthProvider.signOut and devLogin invoke clearScopedQueries() which cancels in-flight queries and clears all cached reads.

audit13_fixture_isolation.separation_status: Product entry graph is strictly decoupled from test/demo fixtures. Production builds fail closed if mock/overlay modules are reachable.
